learning_goals: Explain the assumptions and scope of first-order optimisation methods.
Apply gradient descent and interpret its convergence conditions.
Connect optimisation concepts to potential-energy and relaxation intuition.
target_depth: conceptual and computational introduction with stated theorem conditions
proof_depth: interpret theorem statements and conditions without full proofs
assumptions_requiring_review: Learners can interpret gradients, norms, and simple linear systems when introduced in context.
Mechanical examples are pedagogical models rather than empirical claims.
